mapper.insert: insert into dms_non_drug_item_record (registration_id, status, aim, demand, create_time, no_drug_id, type, create_staff_id, amount) values (#{registrationId}, #{status}, #{aim}, #{demand}, #{createTime}, #{noDrugId}, #{type}, #{createStaffId}, #{amount})
mapper.select: select * from dms_non_drug_item_record where registration_id = #{registrationId} and type = #{type} and (status is null or status <> 2) order by id desc
select COALESCE(sum(amount), 0) from dms_non_drug_item_record where registration_id = #{registrationId} and (status is null or status <> 2)
